releasenotes: Topic pages and notifications with fewer database queries. The clubs shown under post authors no longer reload after every run of IPS's club rebuild task when nothing changed (on the forum we measured that task rewrote all 490 clubs every 20 minutes, with no club active in the meantime, and each run threw away every cached list), and the lists are kept for 6 hours instead of 10 minutes. The notifications dropdown, the notifications page and the REST API notifications list (the mobile app) read the posts, topics and authors they show with one query, and the API skips queries that can never return anything. Language strings in large API responses are replaced about 4 times faster. Every result stays exactly what IPS returns. Each change has its own switch.
